description: This file is a unit test class for the QuickLaunchAPI, part of the OrangeHRM project's dashboard API. It contains test methods that verify the behavior of the QuickLaunchAPI, including fetching all quick launch items with different fixtures, and tests for create, delete, and validation rules that are expected to throw not-implemented exceptions.
